issue.title: sase-core clippy denies manual_range_contains and nonminimal_bool
issue.description:
## CI failure

- **Node:** `sase-core ./scripts/check.sh clippy (-D warnings): clippy::manual_range_contains, clippy::nonminimal_bool`

Proposed by phase bead sase-1ag.1 (note #1, 2026-09-26) while restoring project-tag placement. That phase's `sase tool run check` in linked sase-core stopped on six pre-existing clippy style denies: `manual_range_contains` and `nonminimal_bool` in `crates/sase_core/src/agent_runtime.rs`, `crates/sase_core/src/agent_scan/index/maintenance.rs`, `crates/sase_core/src/fleet_owner_facts.rs`, `crates/sase_core/src/provider_usage/mod.rs`, and `crates/sase_core/src/tool_run/store/triage.rs`. None of those files are in the project-tag commit 24e8f5894f2f4c977ab637c29579b6e12f647820.

This landing rechecked the linked core at HEAD 9f86897f834e9719c44f5e1669a4bd55d312b99c. `git log` since 2026-09-26 11:50 UTC shows no edits to those five files. The range patterns are still present, including `agent_runtime.rs` lines 567, 580, and 626 (`submitted >= start && submitted < end`). `provider_usage/mod.rs` line 974 and `fleet_owner_facts.rs` lines 440-448 still use the negated boolean chains the phase named. This is not a pytest node; the failing gate is the core clippy deny.

No task bead matches `manual_range_contains`, `nonminimal_bool`, or `fleet_owner_facts`. In-progress epics sase-165 (core agent loop speed) and sase-1ah (receipt store) do not own these lints: sase-1ah.2's receipt commit does not modify the flagged files.

Impact: `sase tool run check` in sase-core stays red for every later core change until these denies are rewritten to the clippy-suggested forms.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic clippy -D warnings denies reported by sase-1ag.1 on files that git log shows unchanged through core HEAD 9f86897. Not intermittent: the same style patterns are still in the source, and the phase recorded the flagged lines as identical to HEAD. This landing did not re-run the full core clippy compile; the file identity check is the confirmation.

payload.description: Phase sase-1ag.1 proposed this clippy cleanup while landing project-tag placement; the lints are outside that diff.
